crossRefs.note: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took…
He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures…
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and…
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,
He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a…
“Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.
“For it is like a man, going into another country, who called his own servants, and entrusted his goods to them.
“Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.
He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this…
He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can…
He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of…
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…

translations.web: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.
translations.bsb: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
translations.kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
translations.asv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, who would make a reckoning with his servants.
